In 1925, the use of Pera was removed from official documents and the name Beyoğlu was adopted. Today, Beyoğlu is described as Istanbul's most characteristic district due to its cosmopolitan identity. Present-day Beyoğlu functions as one of the main centers for cultural activities, leisure, and entertainment in Istanbul. Istiklal Avenue and the surrounding streets, along with museums, theaters, galleries, and performance venues, form the commercial and cultural heart of the district.
